bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative framework analysis identifying harms such as cultural barriers, hegemonic classification, safety gaps, value violations, and cultural erasure in AI systems.
Discussion of performance disparities in NLP systems (virtual assistants, QA systems) when handling non-dominant languages and dialects compared to English.
Analysis of computer vision failures (e.g., pedestrian detection) and safety gaps when models trained in Western environments are deployed in the Global South.
